extra.reason: Done in kotile task/initial-implementation: NpotTileSheetTest added (commit f7ef012) alongside the POT-padding fix in TileSheet; renderHarness/spriteHarness added (4ed9ca4).
Decided: option (a) — GameWorld composes ecs.World; Zone becomes terrain-only; occupants become ECS entities tagged with ZoneMember. See docs/adr/0007-game-world-composes-ecs-world.md.

GameWorld composes ecs.World (ADR-0007); Zone is terrain-only (isWalkable terrain-only; creature ownership removed); occupants are ECS entities (Position+ZoneMember+Renderable+Health+Named, Player marker); added GameWorld.entityAt/isWalkable. Deleted Creature + old world.World. Interim movement/AI/lantern glue lives in MyGame, to be replaced by LightingSystem(s5)/MovementSystem+CombatSystem(s6)/BehaviorSystem(s7). 190 tests green.
Done as part of s3's vertical slice: KotileZoneRenderer now reads ECS entities (Position+Renderable+ZoneMember, Player marker -> always drawn) instead of Zone.creatures.

LightingSystem recomputes each zone's lightMap from LightEmitter entities per tick (replaces Zone.recalculateLightMap). Added LightEmitter(color,radius,calculatorId) + LightCalculators registry. Zone keeps lightMap as system-written state, no longer owns lights. Player lantern is now a LightEmitter (tracks movement automatically; interim lantern glue removed). Deleted LightSource. ZoneLightingTest -> LightingSystemTest. 190 tests green.

FIXED — build + Dokka green on mainline (commit da6213c). Root causes: (1) action rot — Java 11 (Gradle 9 needs 17+), archived wrapper-validation-action@v1, Node-20 action versions, 'coretto' typo, dokka V1 task name under V2 mode, stale bucket4k cname; (2) krogue's includeBuild('../kotile') had no kotile on CI; (3) accumulated ktlint violations the broken CI never caught. Fixes: modernized all 4 workflows (setup-java 21, @v4 actions, gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4, dokka :dokkaGenerateHtml + build/dokka/html + permissions:contents:write + peaceiris@v4); added git-clone of kotile sibling; made kotile repo PUBLIC (user-approved) so the clone works; ran ktlintFormat. build+Dokka verified GREEN. pr.yml (PR-only) and release.yml (manual dispatch) fixed by the same patterns, verified by inspection not a live run. Note: GitHub warns @v4 actions still run on Node20 (informational, non-failing; GitHub auto-migrates to Node24).

Movement & combat are systems: MoveIntent + AttackIntent components; MovementSystem resolves MoveIntents (walk/ bump-attack->AttackIntent / wall no-op); CombatSystem applies damage + despawns dead non-player. MyGame registers movement->combat->lighting, routes player input + interim AI through MoveIntent, drops interim moveEntity/attack/dead-removal. Only name-based AI remains interim (->s7 BehaviorSystem). 196 tests (+6), build+ktlint green locally.

Behavior(strategyId) component + BehaviorStrategy/BehaviorStrategies (wander, hunt-player) + BehaviorSystem (injectable resolver) replace the interim name-based AI; creatures spawn with Behavior. Deleted all legacy world entity classes (MovableEntity, Entity, ZonalPosition, Pointer, HighlightedCoordinate); Tile made self-contained (was extending Entity). world/ is now GameWorld+Zone+Tile. 200 tests (+4), build+ktlint green.

Phase 4b complete: all 7 steps done. Existing entities migrated onto the ECS; GameWorld composes ecs.World (ADR-0007); behavior/movement/combat/lighting are systems; legacy world entity classes deleted. 200 tests green.

Multi-zone transitions implemented (ADR-0008). Part 1: active-only simulation seam — GameWorld.simulatedZones() (default {currentZoneId}); BehaviorSystem + LightingSystem scoped via activeZones provider; dormant zones freeze; fixed HuntPlayer cross-zone bug. Part 2: Portal component + PortalSystem (player steps onto stairs -> switch zone + move player + currentZoneId follows); MovementSystem treats portals as non-blocking; renderer rebuilds on zone change. MyGame demo: two zones linked by >/< stairs. 204 tests (+4). Follow-ups: per-zone fog (filed), current+adjacent sim (krogue-s67).

Added com.sletmoe.krogue.random: SerializableRandom (xoshiro256** as a kotlin.random.Random with serializable 4-long state), SplitMix64 (seeding + stream-seed derivation), GameRandom (master seed -> named isolated streams; snapshot/restore). Per ADR-0009: shareable deterministic seeds + exact-resume RNG. MyGame draws worldgen/placement from a 'worldgen' stream and AI/combat from a 'gameplay' stream (same master seed => same world). +9 tests (213). Independently useful before save/load.

Added com.sletmoe.krogue.registry: Registry<T> + GameModule (builder facade; engineDefaults() + consumer additions) bundling per-concern strategy/calculator registries (ADR-0009 hybrid iii). Built-in ids moved onto classes (WanderStrategy.ID, HuntPlayerStrategy.ID, Diminishing/GlobalLightValueCalculator.ID). Deleted LightCalculators + BehaviorStrategies stub objects; BehaviorSystem/LightingSystem resolve via injected narrow seams; MyGame builds GameModule.engineDefaults(). ComponentRegistry/SerializersModule deferred to s3 (CBOR). +3 tests.

CBOR save/load codec (ADR-0009). Added kotlinx-serialization plugin + cbor dep. @Serializable + stable @SerialName discriminators on savable components (Position/ZoneMember/Named/Health/Renderable/Player/LightEmitter/Behavior/Portal) + NormalizedRgb/RenderLayer; Tile @Serializable via GdxColorSerializer (RGBA8888). ComponentRegistry (polymorphic SerializersModule) added to GameModule (component<T>()). RandomState/GameRandomState @Serializable. World.restore/nextEntityId (internal). SaveCodec.save/load over entities+terrain(grids)+RNG+turn+currentZoneId; SaveEnvelope{formatVersion,payload} version-first seam; fail-fast on mismatch; transient components excluded; EntityId+nextId preserved. +2 round-trip tests (218 total). Game owns triggers (not wired into demo).

Phase 4f complete: all 3 steps done (RNG streams, registry/GameModule, CBOR codec) per ADR-0009. Shareable deterministic seeds + exact save/resume delivered; engine-extension story via GameModule. 218 tests green.

Event bus implemented (ADR-0010): generic ecs.EventBus with publish-enqueues/dispatch-delivers model owned by World, drained per-tick; game events EntityDamaged/EntityDied/ZoneChanged emitted by CombatSystem/PortalSystem; 8 EventBus tests + system-test assertions (230 tests total); docs updated.

AI strategy abstraction formalized (machinery landed with 4f registry, ADR-0009): BehaviorStrategy SPI extracted to its own file with consumer contract; built-ins wander/hunt-player; 'Extending the engine' docs (write -> register on GameModule -> tag Behavior(id) -> BehaviorSystem resolves); end-to-end test driving a custom-registered strategy through the real registry. Phase 4 complete.

Per-zone fog memory persists across zone transitions: hoisted the 'previously seen' Grid out of KotileZoneRenderer into a host-owned ZoneFog (one grid per zone, reused on return) and inject it into the renderer, so the rebuild on a zone change no longer wipes exploration. 3 ZoneFog tests (234 total). Save/load persistence of fog filed as krogue-k77.

Fog persists across save/load: added SaveData.fog (per-zone SavedFog, additive/default-empty so old payloads still load — no version bump per ADR-0009), carried by SaveCodec as Map<String,Grid<Boolean>> (codec stays decoupled from the renderer); ZoneFog.snapshot()/restore() bridge it. 4 new tests (codec round-trip + additive default; ZoneFog snapshot/restore), 238 total. Capability is wired+tested but the demo doesn't yet trigger save/load.

Wired save/load into MyGame: F5 saves (codec.save with zoneFog.snapshot()), F9 loads (swaps in loaded world/RNG/fog, re-registers systems, re-resolves player, rebuilds renderer). Verified in-game over 3 save/load cycles incl. across zone transitions; fog persists. Save file gitignored. Save-size (~13MB terrain) filed as krogue-yox.

UI toolkit core landed: TileSurface cell-sink seam (+ text/fill helpers), RegionSurface (clip/translate/z-offset/dim), WindowSurface adapter over AsciiTileWindow, Widget interface, UiRoot (layer stack, single-pass render with dim-behind, modal-capturing input routing), and IntRect split/inset layout helpers. 18 headless tests via a RecordingSurface fake (256 total).

MapPanel landed: the map is now a Widget drawing the current zone into a TileSurface region (player-centred viewport sized to its own pane), composing in UiRoot's single render pass. Replaces/retires KotileZoneRenderer; MyGame rewired through UiRoot+WindowSurface, input routed via ui.handleKey first. MapPanel reads currentZone each frame so zone transitions need no renderer rebuild. 4 headless MapPanel tests (261 total). Verified in-game incl. load.

Frame + BarWidget landed and wired into the demo: Frame draws a CP437 box border + title; BarWidget renders 'LABEL ████░░ cur/max' reading live value each frame; Cp437 glyph constants (font keys by char.code into the 256-cell CP437 sheet). Demo now shows a bordered Status strip with the player's HP bar (green->red as HP drops). 9 headless tests (266 total). Verified in-game. Provides the HP-display half of krogue-4zi.

Dialog + Menu landed and wired into the demo. Menu: selectable list (up/down wrap, Enter activates, inverted highlight). Dialog: opaque modal box (fill + Frame + content) added to UiRoot modal=true so the root dims layers below and routes input to it. Demo: Esc system menu (resume/save/load/quit, pauses world via ui.hasModal) and a non-cancellable game-over dialog at 0 HP. 8 headless tests (274 total). Verified in-game.

Resolved by the UI toolkit: HP is surfaced via a live BarWidget (krogue-bhc) and 0 HP now triggers a modal game-over Dialog (Load last save / Quit) that freezes the world (krogue-wh9). CombatSystem still spares the player from despawn; death is handled at the UI/host layer rather than by removing the entity.

LogPanel landed: bordered, scrollable message log (append + maxLines cap, hard-wrap to interior width, newest at bottom, PageUp/PageDown scroll). Wired into the demo as a right sidebar fed by the event bus (ADR-0010) — its first real consumer: EntityDamaged -> 'X hits Y for N', EntityDied -> 'Z dies' (re-subscribed per buildUi since load swaps the world/bus). 6 headless tests (279 total). Verified in-game.

Inventory landed with a minimal real item model: Item(name)+Inventory(items) serializable components (registered), PickupSystem (walk onto a non-blocking item -> despawn + add to inventory + ItemPickedUp event), and InventoryPanel widget. Demo: items scattered per zone, sidebar stacks Log over Inventory, pickups logged, round-trips through save/load (verified in-game). 9 tests (286 total). UI epic 6/6.

All six children done (ADR-0011): krogue-side UI toolkit in com.sletmoe.krogue.ui — TileSurface/RegionSurface/UiRoot core, MapPanel, Frame, BarWidget, Menu, Dialog, LogPanel, InventoryPanel. Demo is now a multi-pane roguelike (map + log/inventory sidebar + HP status, system menu, game over). Fully headless-tested via RecordingSurface. No kotile changes.

Folded kotile into the korogue repo via git subtree (history preserved, commit 2c451cc): :kotile:library + :kotile:demo subprojects, separate maven coords (com.sletmoe:kotile). Replaced includeBuild composite with include(); engine deps project(:kotile:library); gradle.properties carries gdxVersion/kotestVersion; removed kotile nested settings/wrapper; CI sibling-checkout dropped; docs updated. Verified ./gradlew check (engine+kotile) + ./gradlew run.
Implemented pluggable GameLoop (TurnBasedLoop/RealTimeLoop); MyGame turn-based by default with per-turn AI; lighting primed at startup. Tests pass.
RealTimeLoop is now a fixed-timestep accumulator (stepMs/maxCatchUpSteps); deltaMs threaded through Game.onTick -> GameLoop.advance. World speed is FPS-independent. Tests + build green.

Added turn-keyed Scheduler (fuses/daemons, cancel/lengthen) + TimedEffect extension point + SchedulerSystem; GameModule effects registry; serializable SchedulerState round-tripped via SaveCodec (timers resume across save/load). Demo wired (no effects yet). 17 new tests, ktlint clean.
LightingSystem gains ambientLight baseline + LightValue.FULLBRIGHT; global illumination without faking emitters. Tests added.
Direction enum (8 compass dirs, opposite/from/CARDINAL/DIAGONAL/ofStep/between) + MoveIntent(Direction); WanderStrategy dogfoods it. Tests added.
Label widget (single live text line) in the UI toolkit; Rogue example uses it. Tests added.

korogue-rogue scaffold: separate repo, composite build on korogue, Rogue BSD LICENSE.TXT + NOTICE, runnable RogueGame skeleton (thin shell + RogueModule/LevelFactory/Actors/PlayScreen) wiring the UI toolkit + GameModule. Launches to a globally-lit room you can move around.
MapPanel.maximumVisibilityDistance is now Double?, default null (uncapped/walls-only). Test added. Note: view distance ultimately moves onto a per-observer Vision component in the visibility rework.

Perception core landed: perception package (Perceived, Contribution, Sense/SenseComponent, Suppressor/Concealment, PerceptionModel, StandardPerception two-phase model), PerceptionSystem per-observer cache, GameModule senses+perceptionModels registries. 16 tests added (337 total, green). Ships inert pending 1my.2 (senses) / 1my.3 (concealments).

Added engine sense components (Sight/Darkvision/Tremorsense/Telepathy) as opt-in SenseComponent types, their Sense contributors (tags + LOS/lighting/radius reveal), PerceptionTags constants, registered in engineDefaults() with LOS injected via SymmetricShadowCaster. View distance moved onto Sight.radius. Components registered for save/load. 16 new tests, 353 total green.

MapPanel renders a chosen observer's Perceived (default: player); dropped LOS-and-lit and maximumVisibilityDistance (now Sight.radius), finishing krogue-f50->ADR-0015. PerceptionSystem wired after LightingSystem in both demo and Rogue example; player gets Sight()+Perceived(). LineOfSightCalculator made a fun interface. Engine 356 tests + rogue example build green. Force-closed past the soft dep on krogue-1my.3 (concealment): the two are independent — invisible-monster hiding already works via Perceived.entities once 1my.3 lands its Invisible/Blind components; no rendering change needed there.

Fixed alongside krogue-1my.4: converted the file-overview KDoc blocks in EngineSenses/SenseComponents/Suppression to block comments (no-consecutive-comments), and ktlintFormat fixed the PerceptionSystem import order. ktlintCheck now green.

Concrete suppress-phase payload: Invisible (Concealment{visual}), Blind/Dazzled (Suppressor{visual}) as dataless data-objects + TrueSight built-in sense piercing {visual} (sees invisible, unblinded by design — uniform piercing). Registered for save/load + senses in engineDefaults. Transient blindness scheduler-expirable via fuse removing Blind (krogue-6uq). 10 new tests (TrueSightSense unit + PerceptionScenarioTest E2E); full suite + ktlint green. Completes epic krogue-1my.

All 4 children complete: perception core + two-phase reveal/suppress (1my.1), built-in senses (1my.2), MapPanel renders Perceived (1my.4), concealment/piercing/suppressors (1my.3). Three-layer visibility model per ADR-0015 shipped: illumination + LOS + observer-relative perception via composable senses, tag-based concealment/suppression with piercing, per-observer cache. Engine ships StandardPerception + Sight/Darkvision/TrueSight/Tremorsense/Telepathy + Invisible/Blind/Dazzled.

Faithful port of rooms.c/passages.c/new_level.c in korogue-rogue: LevelGenerator builds an 80x24 3x3 room grid (gone/dark/maze rooms depth-gated), corridor connection-graph with dog-leg passages + doors, gold (entities), traps (terrain, 8 types), down-stairs, entrance. Deterministic from the seeded worldgen stream. 9 Kotest specs incl. connectivity flood-fill over 50 seeds. Verified visually. Follow-up: engine prefab/feature gen capability filed as krogue-b1p.

Player model shipped in korogue-rogue: Stats component (str/maxStr/exp/level/AC/dmg, Rogue INIT_STATS), Regen counter; Strength tables (str_plus/add_dam, 3..31 clamp); Experience ladder + LevelingSystem (check_level: promote + roll(Δlvl,10) HP, player-gated, LeveledUp event); RegenEffect doctor daemon on the scheduler; PlayerDeathSystem (PlayerDied once at 0 HP). Wired into RogueGame + RogueModule; status line shows Str/Arm/Exp. 32 tests + ktlint green.

Rogue item model in com.sletmoe.korogue.examples.rogue.item (korogue-rogue repo): ItemCategory (9 glyphs), ItemTables (obj_info probabilities+worth from extern.c — potions/scrolls/rings/wands/weapons+damage/armor+AC; each sums to 100), Appearances (per-game colors/syllable titles/stones/wand materials, distinct-draw faithful to init.c, serializable), ItemLore (per-game identification + call-it guesses + inv_name/nameit naming + stone-adjusted worth), RogueItem component, ItemFactory.newThing (faithful new_thing: category mix, weapon/armor curse+bless, numeric-ring bonus, wand charges, hunger->food override), Pack (MAXPACK 23, a-z letters, kind/group stacking, wield/wear/ring-on/off, leave_pack pointer fixup). Components registered in RogueModule for save/load. 42 new tests (73 total), ktlint clean. Effects deferred to krogue-m07 (unblocked, with g1w/a4d). Not yet committed (conservative profile).

Monster data + spawning layer (krogue-rogue): MonsterTable (26-monster A-Z table verbatim from extern.c monsters[]; lvl_mons/wand_mons + randmonster from monsters.c, depth-clamped selection), Monster component + MonsterFlag enum (MEAN/FLY/REGEN/INVIS/GREED/HASTE), MonsterFactory (new_monster stat rolls: roll(lvl,8) HP, lev_add depth scaling, exp_add award, give_pack carried items, rnd_thing xeroc disguise; ISINVIS wired to engine Invisible concealment). Per-room population in LevelGenerator.do_rooms (80% gold-guarded / 25% plain, randmonster, MonsterSpot) spawned by LevelFactory. Wandering spawns via scheduler: WanderingMonsterEffect (rollwand/swander cadence — every 4th turn, 1/6, then spread(70) lull) with savable Wandering singleton; registered in RogueModule, started by RogueGame. 16 new tests (90 total), ktlint clean, build green. AI (d5b) and combat (c9m) consume these but are out of scope. Not committed (conservative profile).

Ported fight.c swing/roll_em as a pure Combat object (to-hit vs AC, damage-string parsing incl. multi-attack and 0x0/%%%x0 placeholders, strength to-hit/damage bonuses, weapon/ring hplus/dplus params, sleeping +4) plus RogueCombatSystem wiring AttackIntent -> damage/Health, regen-quiet reset both sides, and experience-on-kill + despawn (killed). Registered after MovementSystem in RogueGame. 18 tests (CombatTest 13, RogueCombatSystemTest 5), all green. Deferred to existing beads: per-monster special attacks on hit (rust/freeze/drain/steal/hold) need status/equip/purse models -> krogue-d5b/m07; sleeping +4 needs monster waking state -> krogue-d5b; reading weapon/armor pluses from equipped Pack + thrown weapons -> krogue-m07/a4d (Combat math already honors the pluses).

Not reproducible: a fresh 'ktlintCheck --rerun-tasks' passes clean and the named files are byte-identical to HEAD. The earlier violation list came from a stale aggregated ktlint report, not the current tree.

Ported chase.c's chase/diag_ok/dist as a pure Chase object (greedy 8-neighbour descent to min squared distance, faithful rnd(++plcnt) tie-break, diag-corner legality, target cell is a valid destination so closing a gap becomes a MovementSystem bump -> RogueCombatSystem attack) and ChaseStrategy (BehaviorStrategy): MEAN-vs-timid aggro gate, bat/phantom innate-confusion random moves, monster-occupancy avoidance, same-zone gate. Wired: MonsterFactory tags Behavior(rogue-chase), RogueModule registers the strategy bound to world.zones, RogueGame runs BehaviorSystem before MovementSystem. 13 tests (ChaseTest 7, ChaseStrategyTest 6) green; ktlint clean. Monsters now hunt and melee the player end-to-end. Deferred (engine seam / missing models), filed + linked: latched wake/scared/confused -> krogue-aki; HASTE/FLY/SLOW double/half-move -> krogue-upf; greed gold-guard + room/door routing -> krogue-0yr; on-hit special attacks -> krogue-2u9.

Rogue command set + UI delivered across three slices on krogue-rogue. Slice 1: three-band screen (message line via RogueLog/RogueMessages formatting fight.c hit/miss/killed + pickups + level-ups, erase-on-input; full rogue.c status line) + '.' rest + '?' help overlay. Slice 2: init_player starting pack + Purse, ItemLore singleton, Equipment.profileOf wiring wielded weapon + worn armor into RogueCombatSystem (closed c9m's weapon/armor hook), RoguePickupSystem (gold->purse, items->pack), 'i' inventory overlay with equip tags. Slice 3: equipment-change commands w/W/T (wield/wear/take-off) with a letter-keyed item-selection modal (Chooser), Shift-disambiguated. 143 tests green, ktlint clean throughout. Remaining command set is blocked on other systems and tracked separately: item-use q/r/e/z/t/identify -> krogue-m07; drop 'd' + floor-item placement + pickup-on-move -> krogue-rx2; stairs >/< + descend -> krogue-go8; rings P/R need obtainable rings (m07/rx2); run(HJKL)/search/options are minor polish.

All three pieces on krogue-rogue. (1) put_things (new_level.c): LevelGenerator scatters up to MAXOBJ=9 items, each a 36% roll of ItemFactory.newThing on a free floor cell, carried as ItemSpot in DungeonLayout and spawned by LevelFactory via the new shared FloorItem.spawn (glyph + engine Item marker + RogueItem). (2) pickup-on-move: RoguePickupSystem now fires only when the player enters a new (zone,cell), so resting on loot doesn't repeatedly grab it and a dropped item isn't snatched back the same turn. (3) drop 'd': prompt-select a pack slot, lay one on the floor at the player's feet (FloorItem.spawn), spend a turn. +3 tests (put_things placement x2, move-trigger x1); 154 total, green; ktlint clean. This makes the whole item/equipment/potion system reachable in play: loot can now be found, picked up, equipped, quaffed (krogue-m07), and dropped. Treasure rooms + Amulet gating in put_things left for later; descend/stairs is krogue-go8.
Stairs + multi-level regeneration done; engine + rogue tests green, ktlint clean, ADR-0016 recorded. Amulet gate/win deferred to krogue-5yu as planned.

Amulet of Yendor placed from AMULETLEVEL (26) down (LevelGenerator put_things + LevelFactory !amulet gate); '<' ascent gated on the amulet and wins off level 1 (total_winner); death->tombstone and win->worth-listing scoring (rip.c) via Score + EndScreen; killer tracked through LastAttacker (save/load registered). Implemented in the korogue-rogue repo.

Ported weapons.c missile/do_motion/fall as ThrowEffects + the 't' command in RogueGame. do_motion flies the weapon straight until a monster/wall/door; a monster is fought as a thrown blow (roll_em hurl=TRUE: hurl dice, launcher bonus only while the matching bow is wielded, else feeble wield dice for an un-launched arrow; thrown enchant counts, rings don't, no +4 sleeping bonus per krogue-aki), thunk/bounce + defeated messages, XP/despawn on kill, weapon spent on a landing hit. Miss/no-monster falls (fallpos reservoir over FLOOR/PASSAGE 3x3, never the hero) or vanishes. Cursed wielded weapon refuses; un-cursed one is unwielded first. 4 tests, 231 green, ktlint clean.

Ported S_PROTECT/S_CREATE/S_SCARE in ScrollEffects + the read command. Protect sets RogueItem.protected (ISPROT) on worn armor ('shimmering gold shield'); create reservoir-picks a step_ok 3x3 cell (excludes hero + scare scrolls) and spawns randmonster(FALSE) via MonsterFactory, scaling to depth, else 'faint cry of anguish'; scare reading yields 'maniacal laughter'. None auto-identify (faithful to oi_know). apply() now takes GameWorld+depth (threaded through readCommand); success-with-no-message create suppresses a blank log line. RogueItem gains protected:Boolean (consumed later by rust, krogue-2u9). 5 new tests, ScrollEffects 15 green, full suite green, ktlint clean.

Ported the hunger clock (daemons.c stomach + misc.c eat). New Hunger component (food_left + hungry_state) on the player, starting at HUNGERTIME=1300; HungerEffect daemon (period-1, like RegenEffect) burns 1/turn (less with a slow-digestion ring or the Amulet, more with a hungry ring — faithful ring_eat uses[] table), announces the <300 'hungry' and <150 'weak' crossings, faints (no_command/ASLEEP, rnd(8)+4) on a 1-in-5 once empty, and kills by starvation past -STARVETIME (850), recorded as the 'starvation' killer (article suppressed on the tombstone). The 'e' eat command (EatEffects) refills HUNGERTIME-200+rnd(400) capped at STOMACHSIZE=2000, clears state, fruit='slime-mold', a ~30% awful ration grants +1 exp (LevelingSystem promotes). Status line shows Hungry/Weak/Faint. 13 tests, suite 249 green, ktlint clean. no_food food-drop pressure split to its own issue.

Ported scrolls.c S_MAP. ScrollEffects returns Outcome('oh, now this scroll has a map on it', identified, FollowUp.RevealMap); the read command handles RevealMap by flooding the current zone's ZoneFog memory to fully explored via MagicMapping.reveal, so MapPanel draws all remembered terrain (passages/doors/walls/stairs/^traps — which are plain tiles here). Terrain only; monsters/items aren't revealed. 2 tests (MagicMapping flood + the S_MAP outcome); the prior which=1 'unimplemented' test repointed to S_AGGR(16). Suite 252 green, ktlint clean.

Ported potions.c P_MFIND. New Status.DETECT_MONSTERS (SEEMONST) set for HUHDURATION=20 turns by PotionEffects; MonsterDetectionSystem bridges it to the engine's whole-zone Telepathy sense (added when active, removed when it lapses), so PerceptionSystem reveals every monster and MapPanel draws them. Not auto-identified (turn_see sets no oi_know -> call_it); 'strange feeling' only when nothing new is revealed; quaff suppresses the empty message when monsters appear. 5 tests (2 PotionEffects + 3 system), suite 257 green, ktlint clean. Split from krogue-oaz (which now covers the one-shot reveal windows S_FDET/P_TFIND).

Ported S_FDET (scrolls.c food detection) and P_TFIND (potions.c magic detection) one-shot reveal windows. New ItemDetection helper scans the level's floor items: food() marks each ration with the ':' glyph, magic() marks each is_magic item with '$' (potions.c is_magic ported: potions/scrolls/wands/rings/amulet always; armor when protected or AC beats base; weapon when +hit/+dam). Effects return a shared RevealWindow(message, markers); the quaff/read commands open a new modal RevealOverlay in PlayScreen (Rogue's show_win) — a blank field with the markers translated through MapPanel's player-centred camera and the --More-- banner up top, dismissed by space/escape. oi_know matches C: identified only when something shows, else 'your nose tingles' / 'strange feeling'. Monster t_pack magic deferred (korogue monsters carry no inventory yet — krogue-2u9). 12 tests (ItemDetectionTest + 2 PotionEffects + 2 ScrollEffects), full suite green, ktlint clean.

Ported Rogue's no_food hunger pressure (extern.c/new_level.c/things.c). New FoodPressure holder carries the counter as persistent game state on Dungeon; threaded by reference into LevelFactory.create/addLevel -> LevelGenerator. generate() increments it once per level (new_level.c:55 no_food++, before put_things); putThings() passes it to ItemFactory.newThing and resets to 0 on any rolled ration (things.c:245). ItemFactory already honored noFood>3 -> force FOOD (things.c:235); now the counter is actually threaded, so the hunger clock (krogue-fwh) can't starve the hero on unlucky drops — food is guaranteed at least every 4th level. give_pack's shared-no_food path left out (korogue rolls monster packs post-layout, an ordering divergence harmless to the starvation guarantee; documented in FoodPressure). 5 new tests (2 LevelGenerator property tests for increment/reset/force across 50 seeds, 1 Dungeon cross-level integration), full suite green, ktlint clean.

Ported all find-first-monster utility staves in WandEffects: WS_INVIS, WS_POLYMORPH, WS_HASTE_M/WS_SLOW_M (permanent MonsterFlag.SLOW added; speed change is krogue-upf), WS_TELAWAY/WS_TELTO, WS_CANCEL (MonsterFlag.CANCELLED added) + the flytrap-hold release. WS_LIGHT and WS_DRAIN need the room model and moved to krogue-sdh.5 (blocked on krogue-kj5). 13 WandEffectsTest cases pass.

Implemented as a whole-frame composite cache (GridCompositeCache): TileRenderer/AsciiTileWindow recomposite into an offscreen FrameBuffer only when dirty (writes, resize, or any animated tile present), then blit it as one sprite through the existing scaled/sharp-bilinear-aware canvas.drawSprite path. Scoped to the internal-tilemap render()/asLayer() path only; the external-tilemap render(source, viewport) overload (shared/multi-pane tilemaps) is out of scope, documented in ADR-0024. Verified via new GL-gated unit tests plus a live demo pixel-diff (:demo:animationShowcaseHarness) against pre-change output, which caught and fixed two real bugs invisible to isolated single-canvas tests: GL viewport clobbering by FrameBuffer.end(), and FrameBuffer color-texture defaulting to linear (not nearest) filtering. Full design/tradeoffs in docs/adr/0024-dirty-region-redraw-grid-composite-cache.md.

Implemented: GridCompositeCache now tracks dirty cells individually (markCellDirty/markAllDirty) instead of one whole-frame flag, with two recomposite paths -- fully-dirty (one clear + batched pass, same cost as before) and partially-dirty (per-cell glScissor + clear + draw + immediate batch flush, so untouched cells keep their existing FBO pixels). The sticky 'any animated tile marks everything forever' flag is replaced by a HashSet<Vector2Int> of animated positions, recomputed from ground truth on every single-cell write (refreshAnimatedTrackingAt) rather than incrementally counted, so it can't drift. clearLayer now scans for cells actually populated on that layer before clearing and only marks those, not the whole grid. render(source, viewport) remains out of scope (krogue-c0q). Verified via a new differential technique: two windows/renderers draw the same final content (one via first-paint-then-partial-update exercising the scissored path, the other built directly in one shot as a trusted whole-grid reference) via temporary demo harnesses, diffed pixel-for-pixel -- both the ASCII (single-layer-wins) and sprite (bottom-up multi-layer) paths came back pixel-identical, including a moved sprite and a cleared cell. Full writeup appended to docs/adr/0024-dirty-region-redraw-grid-composite-cache.md's Update section (kept in one ADR per user direction rather than filing a separate one).

Implemented: LayeredTilemap gained a per-position version counter (versionAt), bumped by every write touching that position -- a query, not a consumable event, so any number of observers can read it independently without stepping on each other. A new ViewportDirtyTracker (paired with its own GridCompositeCache, separate from the internal-tilemap one) does per-observer bookkeeping for render(source, viewport) on both TileRenderer and AsciiTileWindow: compares each visible cell's versionAt against what THIS tracker last recorded, invalidating everything on a changed TileViewport origin or a different source instance. Animated entries still force a cell dirty via an isAnimatedAt callback, same pattern as krogue-oxi. Verified with the exact scenario the ticket describes: two windows sharing one world tilemap at different viewport origins, each written to differently, window A rendered first then window B -- B came back pixel-identical to a fresh reference (built from the same final state directly), confirming the 'flag stolen by whichever renders first' bug does not occur. Added two permanent GL-gated regression tests to ViewportIntegrationTest. Full writeup appended to docs/adr/0024-dirty-region-redraw-grid-composite-cache.md's second Update section.

Added two GL-gated tests to ViewportIntegrationTest.kt: (1) scroll invalidation on a persistent (reused) window across two render(source, viewport) calls, verifying the newly-revealed column paints and scrolled-off content doesn't linger; (2) an AnimatedAsciiTile on a shared source rendered by the same window across two frames with no writes between, verifying isAnimatedAt keeps it animating. Added RenderingLifecycleIntegrationTest.kt covering all four cases: (a) double dispose() on AsciiTileWindow and SpriteTileRenderer is a clean no-op; (b) render() before any cell is written produces a valid clear-color frame, no NPE; (c) resize mid-use (grow x2, shrink, then a degenerate 1x1 grid) on a persistent window reallocates the cache and redraws correctly at each new size; (d) disposing one window sharing a canvas/font leaves it usable by a second window. Fixed via ADR-0025: the world now owns its GameRandom. World(random: GameRandom = GameRandom.random()); World.tick() lost its random parameter entirely and draws TickContext.random from the world's GameRandom.GAMEPLAY stream; GameWorld.Builder/create thread the master seed and default zone() to the WORLDGEN stream; Zone.Builder/create keep an explicit random but now REQUIRED (no Random.Default default); SaveCodec.save() reads world.random instead of taking it as a separate arg (a mismatched world/RNG pair is now unrepresentable). New World.tickContext() replaces the TickContext(random=Random.Default) priming hack both consumers had independently hand-rolled. All four Random.Default entry points named in the bead are gone.

Acceptance criteria met: engine/src/test/.../random/DeterminismTest.kt proves same-seed replay of worldgen + 20 ticks, divergence on a different seed (non-vacuity guard), and exact save/load resume (10 ticks + save + load + 10 ticks == 20 straight) — none of it passing an RNG anywhere.

Also fixed a latent bug in korogue-rogue this surfaced: LevelFactory built its world with GameWorld.create { } while RogueGame held the real GameRandom beside it — two RNG roots for one game. Migrated korogue-rogue in the same pass (Dungeon lost its worldgen ctor param; Dungeon.begin takes one GameRandom instead of two streams). korogue 788 tests + rogue 585 tests green; ktlint clean (korogue); rogue lint debt is pre-existing, filed as rogue-fom.

Both hierarchies reconciled onto one scheme (ADR-0027): sealed SpriteTile/AsciiTile bases -> Static{Sprite,Ascii}Tile + Dynamic{Sprite,Ascii}Tile branches -> Animated{Sprite,Ascii}Tile built-in impls. Also closed the structural asymmetry: added the open DynamicAsciiTile branch so consumers can write custom time-driven ASCII cells, as they always could for sprites. That exposed a latent bug, now fixed: AsciiTileWindow keyed per-frame repaint on 'is AnimatedAsciiTile' (concrete class) rather than the branch, so a consumer's own dynamic tile would have painted once and frozen.

Verified: full ./gradlew build green (tests + ktlint) in korogue; korogue-rogue force-recompiled and its tests pass with zero changes — it imports only kotile's Vector2Int/Grid, so the engine's TileSurface hides the hierarchy entirely.
